title: Well Adjusted | KEY.co
description_expanded: Located in the heart of the charming Seacrest Beach community, this Southern gem offers the perfect blend of elegance and comfort for an unforgettable coastal retreat. Featuring three master suites and two additional guest bedrooms, including a whimsical bunk room, the home provides ample space for families and friends to unwind together. Inside, every detail is thoughtfully designed, with luxurious finishes like gleaming wood floors, stone countertops, and stainless-steel appliances enhancing its timeless beauty. Soft, inviting hues create a serene atmosphere, while the seamless flow of the open layout ensures a warm and welcoming stay. Step outside and savor the tranquil charm of four covered porches, each inviting you to relax and soak in the coastal breeze. The back porch swing is a standout feature, perfect for unwinding with a good book or a refreshing drink. Whether enjoying the charm of the indoors or the soothing allure of the outdoor spaces, this home is a sanctuary of grace and relaxation. Nestled in a vibrant community with easy access to stunning beaches, local dining, and outdoor adventures, this Seacrest Beach haven is where cherished memories are made.
